correctness.rationale: For any projection onto ker(mu_w), I-P factors through the one-dimensional quotient, giving a unique correction with mu_w(g)=1. Directly, the Riesz measure of evaluation of P_g at x is delta_x-g(x)mu_w; the two measures are mutually singular since mu_w is nonatomic, so taking the supremum of their total-variation norms gives 1+||g||_infty. For a budget L and amplitude M the pointwise difference is bounded by 2 min(M,Lt), achieved at every t by the clipped ramp. The maximal moment over all amplitudes is L/L_c, including the zero-budget case, and strict positivity gives strict increase of F_L before La. An optimal g has equality at every t by continuity and positivity almost everywhere. Within the unsaturated region, equality in the Lipschitz bound forces slope L across each nested symmetric segment. Beyond the clipping point equality in the amplitude forces both signed plateaus. At L=L_c the segment is the whole interval, and the endpoint bounds still fix the additive constant to zero. The exact deficit is 2 times the integral of w(t)(M_L-Lt) from zero to M_L/L. Positivity near zero gives M_L>1, monotonicity and dominated convergence give M_L decreasing to 1, and continuity at zero prevents attaining the unrestricted norm. Substitution t=(M_L/L)s establishes the density coefficient by an integrable s^beta(1-s) bound. Direct integration for the normalized power densities gives the scalar equation; expansion around M=1 gives the quadratic term, and L_min follows by inversion on 1<M<=L/2 or saturation at the threshold, with matching branches at epsilon=1/(beta+1).
residual_risks: Optimizer uniqueness requires positivity almost everywhere on the whole half-interval and finite feasible L. The sharp rate requires the stated near-zero power ratio; it is not uniform over varying densities or exponents.

value.rationale: This measures a genuine distinction that the constant 2 erases: the regularity needed to approach the unattained optimum. The exact feasible curve, uniqueness (including the threshold), and sharp dependence on the density near the sign interface provide quantitative information for a natural class of hyperplanes. The power family realizes every positive rate and turns a norm tolerance into an exact budget. The contribution is that structural package, not a new duality or the isolated uniform-density algebra.
residual_risks: Quantitative interpretation is confined to the stated symmetric real density family and the stated correction budget.
